label: Bible Study
prompt: Yet man is born unto trouble, as the _____ fly upward.
verse: Yet man is born unto trouble, as the sparks fly upward.
note: Eliphaz, the first of Job's friends to speak — true enough on trouble, wrong about why Job had it.

label: Warm-Up Word
prompt: And Jacob awaked out of his sleep, and he said, Surely the LORD is in this _____; and I knew it not.
verse: And Jacob awaked out of his sleep, and he said, Surely the LORD is in this place; and I knew it not.
note: Jacob wakes from his ladder dream on a stone pillow and realizes God was there all along — he just hadn't noticed.

label: Sunday School
prompt: And, lo, the angel of the Lord came upon them, and the glory of the Lord shone round about them: and they were _____ afraid.
verse: And, lo, the angel of the Lord came upon them, and the glory of the Lord shone round about them: and they were sore afraid.
note: 'Sore afraid' is KJV for terrified — an angel plus the glory of the Lord will do that to a shepherd.

label: Deep Water
prompt: And all the inhabitants of the earth are reputed as nothing: and he doeth according to his will in the army of heaven, and among the inhabitants of the earth: and none can _____ his hand, or say unto him, What doest thou?
verse: And all the inhabitants of the earth are reputed as nothing: and he doeth according to his will in the army of heaven, and among the inhabitants of the earth: and none can stay his hand, or say unto him, What doest thou?
note: Nebuchadnezzar's confession after his season of madness in the fields: no one can hold back God's hand.

label: Don't Play With Me
prompt: Then the eyes of the blind shall be opened, and the ears of the deaf shall be _____.
verse: Then the eyes of the blind shall be opened, and the ears of the deaf shall be unstopped.
note: Blind eyes opened, deaf ears 'unstopped' — Jesus pointed John the Baptist's disciples to exactly these signs (Matthew 11:5).
